verses.ar: لِإِمَامِ ٱلْمُغَنِّينَ عَلَى «ذَوَاتِ ٱلْأَوْتَارِ». قَصِيدَةٌ لِدَاوُدَ عِنْدَمَا أَتَى ٱلزِّيفِيُّونَ وَقَالُوا لِشَاوُلَ: «أَلَيْسَ دَاوُدُ مُخْتَبِئًا عِنْدَنَا؟».
verses.en: For the Leader; with string-music. Maschil of David:
verses.kjv: To the chief Musician on Neginoth, Maschil, [A Psalm] of David, when the Ziphims came and said to Saul, Doth not David hide himself with us?
verses.web: For the Chief Musician. On stringed instruments. A contemplation by David, when the Ziphites came and said to Saul, “Isn’t David hiding himself among us?”

verses.he: בְּבֹ֣וא הַ֭זִּיפִים וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ לְשָׁא֑וּל הֲלֹ֥א דָ֝וִ֗ד מִסְתַּתֵּ֥ר עִמָּֽנוּ׃
verses.en: when the Ziphites came and said to Saul: 'Doth not David hide himself with us?'

verses.ar: اَللَّهُمَّ، بِٱسْمِكَ خَلِّصْنِي، وَبِقُوَّتِكَ ٱحْكُمْ لِي.
verses.en: O God, save me by Thy name, and right me by Thy might.
verses.kjv: Save me, O God, by thy name, and judge me by thy strength.
verses.web: Save me, God, by your name. Vindicate me in your might.

verses.ar: ٱسْمَعْ يَا ٱللهُ صَلَاتِي. ٱصْغَ إِلَى كَلَامِ فَمِي.
verses.en: O God, hear my prayer; give ear to the words of my mouth.
verses.kjv: Hear my prayer, O God; give ear to the words of my mouth.
verses.web: Hear my prayer, God. Listen to the words of my mouth.

verses.he: כִּ֤י זָרִ֨ים ׀ קָ֤מוּ עָלַ֗י וְֽ֭עָרִיצִים בִּקְשׁ֣וּ נַפְשִׁ֑י לֹ֤א שָׂ֨מוּ אֱלֹהִ֖ים לְנֶגְדָּ֣ם סֶֽלָה׃
verses.ar: لِأَنَّ غُرَبَاءَ قَدْ قَامُوا عَلَيَّ، وَعُتَاةً طَلَبُوا نَفْسِي. لَمْ يَجْعَلُوا ٱللهَ أَمَامَهُمْ. سِلَاهْ.
verses.en: For strangers are risen up against me, and violent men have sought after my soul; they have not set God before them. Selah
verses.kjv: For strangers are risen up against me, and oppressors seek after my soul: they have not set God before them. Selah.
verses.web: For strangers have risen up against me. Violent men have sought after my soul. They haven’t set God before them. Selah.

verses.he: הִנֵּ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהִים עֹזֵ֣ר לִ֑י אֲ֝דֹנָ֗י בְּֽסֹמְכֵ֥י נַפְשִֽׁי׃
verses.ar: هُوَذَا ٱللهُ مُعِينٌ لِي. ٱلرَّبُّ بَيْنَ عَاضِدِي نَفْسِي.
verses.en: Behold, God is my helper; the Lord is for me as the upholder of my soul.
verses.kjv: Behold, God [is] mine helper: the Lord [is] with them that uphold my soul.
verses.web: Behold, God is my helper. The Lord is the one who sustains my soul.

verses.ar: يَرْجِعُ ٱلشَّرُّ عَلَى أَعْدَائِي. بِحَقِّكَ أَفْنِهِمْ.
verses.en: He will requite the evil unto them that lie in wait for me; destroy Thou them in Thy truth.
verses.kjv: He shall reward evil unto mine enemies: cut them off in thy truth.
verses.web: He will repay the evil to my enemies. Destroy them in your truth.

verses.he: בִּנְדָבָ֥ה אֶזְבְּחָה־לָּ֑ךְ אֹ֤ודֶה שִּׁמְךָ֖ יְהוָ֣ה כִּי־טֹֽוב׃
verses.ar: أَذْبَحُ لَكَ مُنْتَدِبًا. أَحْمَدُ ٱسْمَكَ يَارَبُّ لِأَنَّهُ صَالِحٌ.
verses.en: With a freewill-offering will I sacrifice unto Thee; I will give thanks unto Thy name, O LORD, for it is good.
verses.kjv: I will freely sacrifice unto thee: I will praise thy name, O LORD; for [it is] good.
verses.web: With a free will offering, I will sacrifice to you. I will give thanks to your name, Yahweh, for it is good.

verses.he: כִּ֣י מִכָּל־צָ֭רָה הִצִּילָ֑נִי וּ֝בְאֹיְבַ֗י רָאֲתָ֥ה עֵינִֽי׃
verses.ar: لِأَنَّهُ مِنْ كُلِّ ضِيْقٍ نَجَّانِي، وَبِأَعْدَائِي رَأَتْ عَيْنِي.
verses.en: For He hath delivered me out of all trouble; and mine eye hath gazed upon mine enemies.
verses.kjv: For he hath delivered me out of all trouble: and mine eye hath seen [his desire] upon mine enemies.
verses.web: For he has delivered me out of all trouble. My eye has seen triumph over my enemies.
